title: Social media influencer Jack Doherty arrested for domestic violence in Florida
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Social media influencer Jack Doherty was arrested in Florida again — this time for domestic violence.

Doherty, 22, was charged with misdemeanor domestic battery after getting into a physical altercation with a woman in Fort Lauderdale on Friday, police said.

Officers arrested Doherty after responding to a “domestic dispute” just before 12 p.m. in the Riverside Park neighborhood, the Fort Lauderdale Police Department told The Post.

Initial information determined that Doherty and “a female victim got into a physical dispute inside a residence,” police said.

The female, who has not been identified, was not injured in the dispute.

Doherty was taken into custody and booked into the Broward County Main Jail, police said.

In his latest mugshot, the 22-year-old appears to be sporting a cut on his cheek — but it is unclear if the gash was sustianed during the dispute.

While specific details regarding the “domestic dispute” remain unclear, a source close to Doherty said he acted in self-defense, TMZ reported.

The influencer, who has over 15 million subscribers on YouTube alone, is no stranger to scandal.

Doherty has been slapped with a slew of traffic infractions and misdemeanors within the Miami area between 2022 and 2026, Broward County online records show.

He was booked into the Miami-Dade County Jail in November 2025 on drug possession and resisting arrest charges.

Moments before he was arrested, Doherty challenged cops to a duel while standing in the middle of a Miami street.

“You think you’re funny? If you’re gonna be funny, get out of the f–king street. I don’t know who the f–k you think you are, bro,” a Miami Beach police officer said to the 22-year-old, according to a now-deleted TikTok video.

“All right, we challenge you to a duel,” Doherty says in a loud voice to a group of roughly half a dozen police officers, footage showed.

Doherty was repeatedly warned by police to get off the sidewalk before he was ultimately cuffed.

At the time of arrest, Doherty was carrying amphetamine and marijuana.

The social media star described his November 2025 arrest as the worst day of his life, where he spent hours in multiple holding cells before being released on $3,500 bail, according to TMZ.

Doherty boasts over 28 million followers across all his social media platforms and is known for his viral prank videos.

He infamously totaled his $200,000 McLaren supercar while reportedly texting and driving in the rain during a livestream in October 2024.

During the livestream on the platform, Kick, the online star was seen looking down at his phone as he drove along a slippery Miami highway.

Seconds later, he lost control of his sports car and screamed as he slid across the right lane and smashed into a guardrail.

“All my money’s gone,” Doherty said after the wreck.

The internet personality was banned from Kick after the collision.
